$comment: Documented exceptions to the provenance rule (every live table, column, policy and function is named by a numbered migration). Entries carry a `kind`: `column` (the default — {table, column|null}), `policy` ({table, name}), `function` ({name, args} — the argument types as oidvectortypes prints them), `trigger` ({table, name}) or `grant` ({name, args}), each with the file it came from and the migration that will retire it. `npm run check:schema` fails on drift NOT listed here and on entries that have become stale — this file only ever shrinks. EMPTY since the baselines 190–193 (data foundation P2–P5, Sep 14 2026); the catalog facets (policies, functions — provenance round, Sep 15 2026; triggers, grants — the hygiene sweep, Sep 16 2026) added the kinds. A new entry needs a reason and the migration that retires it.
